prompts:
Use case: illustration-story. ORIGINAL HERO FRONTIER full-color manga, ONE landscape 16:9 comic page about 2048x1152. Actual sequential manga, 5 unequal panels, clear LEFT TO RIGHT/TOP TO BOTTOM reading. Bold expressive clean ink outlines, hand-drawn handsome mature characters, detailed painterly fantasy environments, rich color cel shading, dramatic close-ups and varied shot sizes. Thin cream gutters and dark panel borders, NOT slideshow, NOT game UI, NOT text column next to one illustration. Readable horizontal Traditional Chinese speech balloons with tails correctly pointing to speakers, no writing beyond specified dialogue/captions/title; no English, watermarks, panel numbers. Mood warm, engaging, lived-in, humane, not solemn exposition. No war or villain. This is the peaceful historical period BEFORE modern playable heroes: ONLY ordinary unnamed people, no royalty, no recognizable main heroes. Consistent recurring ordinary cast: human dock carpenter age40, short chestnut hair, short beard, faded BLUE rolled-sleeve shirt and TAN leather apron, square sturdy face (NOT gold-armored hero); Silverleaf MALE caravan hand, pointed ears, long CHESTNUT hair tied halfway back, GREEN cloak with leaf clasp and ivory tunic, leather work gloves, gentle green eyes; Shadowfolk FEMALE civilian mage, pale skin, WHITE shoulder-length hair, VIOLET eyes, deep PURPLE hood lowered behind head, silver-trimmed robe, NO daggers/armor (not the named rogue heroine). Plain cloth goods crate has two iron bands and blue fabric corner. Human stone riverside market + natural green wooded hills + simple timber docks. No exact years, no ancient soul magic, no ancestry claims. Match these character identities and costumes in every panel. Text very legible black Traditional Chinese, generous white balloon padding, do not obscure faces/hands. Scene should act out collaboration without turning it into a history lecture.
PAGE 4: title 「不必每次都道別」. Continuation after the first job, recurring same ordinary workers, warm character-driven sequential comic. Five panels, 2 upper,3lower with lastlarge. Panel1 wide road and wagon departing riverside; same human carpenter waves to Silverleaf man and Shadowfolk woman beside wagon, exchange looks. Caption 「後來，他們又一起走過許多段路。」 Panel2 another visit implied by different market awning light, carpenter warmly gestures newly repaired workshop, Silverleaf presents timber, mage greets workers, human speech 「你們回來了！」 Panel3 dusk modest roadside camp on another journey, tired human rubbing shoulder by cooking pot, companions resting near wagon, NOT a battlefield or threatened camp; mage bubble 「又要趕在天黑前找落腳處。」 Panel4 soft closeup Silverleaf man thoughtful, green eyes and leaf clasp, looking toward warm village lamps in valley, bubble 「要是有個地方，大家都能留下呢？」 Panel5 large human carpenter looks toward same lights, companions listen, thoughtful hopeful rather than triumphant, bubble 「不只交換貨物……也一起生活？」 Page should plant a human desire for a common home, NOT announce city founded by these specific civilians. No royal characters or king, no destruction, no invented hostility between peaceful races.

PAGE 5: title 「一座共同的城」. Five panels in two rows, first upperleftwide meeting panorama, upperrightresponse, lowerleftmapdetail, lowercenterconversation, lowerrightwidefutureland. History dramatization of HUMANS proposing a city where different peoples can live together; don't crown anyone or identify an individual as sole founder. Panel1 ordinary open-air meeting at wooden communal table near riverside, human builders and traders (including same blue-shirt tan-apron carpenter), Silverleaf citizens green earthcolors and brown hair, Shadowfolk citizens whitehair darkpurple, warm equal seating, no throne. Caption 「人類提出了一個更大的想法。」 Human representative in simple BLUE coat, no armor/crown (not the carpenter), speech 「一起建一座城，讓不同族群都能住下來。」 Panel2 SAME Silverleaf male caravan hand speaks sincerely not angrily 「那不只是蓋房子，還要學著一起生活。」 Panel3 tabletop close-up multiple distinct sleeves (blue human, green elf, violet mage), human hand indicating rough architecture drawing of bridges, market homes, NO readable letters on drawing. Off-panel human representative balloon 「法律和管理方式，也一起商量。」 Panel4 SAME Shadowfolk whitehaired woman asks attentive thoughtful face 「每一族，都能參與嗎？」 Human representative visible replying modestly 「這座城，本來就該一起建立。」 Panel5 landscape river clearing, gathered diverse builders survey site and carry tools, no finished palace, no giant city's suddenappearance. Recurring three at foreground looking down valley, no dialogue. Sense of shared resolve and future hard work. Not a coronation, magic pact or written constitution with invented new rules.

PAGE 6: title 「把想法，建成家」. Five panels colored sequential manga, upper row2 medium panels, middle row2 detail panels, bottom wide emotional architecture reveal. Early building works become a lively modest common settlement via montage, NOT complete fully grown metropolis in a day. Panel1 human carpenter same blue shirt tan apron measures timber joint with square, cooperates with Shadowfolk woman same violet robe casting subtle normal lilac lifting light beneath beam, human bubble 「再往這邊一點。」 mage bubble 「這樣？」 Panel2 SAME Silverleaf brown-haired greencloak man kneels at irrigation channel beside gardens, explains to ordinary human worker how channel goes past roots without harming trees, bubble 「把水留給樹，也留給住在這裡的人。」 No definitive supernatural cosmology, no souls or ghosttrees. Panel3 close-up workers' gloved hands with blue green purple sleeves secure beam together, human bubble 「對，就是這裡！」 Panel4 shared simple meal outside half-finished houses, same three characters rest smiling, other mixed workers passing bowls, mage playful bubble 「今天不用急著趕路了。」 Panel5 large panorama after an unspecified gradual time passage: lively beginnings of common riverside settlement, human stone arches and timber frames, living trees and gardens between homes, gentle magical street lanterns, stone bridges, scaffolding stillvisible, diverse people walking normally. Recurring three in foreground backside identifiable clothing surveying their work. Small narration 「一座共同生活的城市，逐漸有了模樣。」 End with quiet hopeful accomplishment, not claim all construction complete, not show political struggle yet, no war or unapproved royalty.
